result.summary: This PR exposes the internal PubkeyProvider interface and adds a public ParsePubkey() function so external callers (notably the GUI) can parse and validate a standalone descriptor key expression using P2TR rules. It also fixes a musig() parser bug that silently accepted unexpected trailing characters after the closing parenthesis, and adds a GetOriginInfo() accessor for explicit key origin data. Extensive new unit tests cover extended keys, raw keys, musig, multipath, and invalid-key cases.
result.problem: The GUI's planned multisig setup wizard (tracked in issue #35645) needs a way to validate a pasted key expression and inspect the parsed key (e.g. reject private or uncompressed keys) without duplicating descriptor parsing logic. Currently PubkeyProvider and its parser are private to descriptor.cpp, so no consumer outside the descriptor code can reuse this validation.

open_concerns: uqlidi (2026-08-28) questions why the new public ParsePubkey() overload hardcodes P2TR key rules rather than taking a script context parameter, suggesting it may be too narrow for other use cases. No author response yet.

result.card: This PR exposes the internal PubkeyProvider interface and adds a public ParsePubkey() function in descriptor.h/cpp so external code, specifically a planned GUI multisig setup wizard (tracked in issue #35645), can parse and validate a standalone key expression and apply policy like rejecting uncompressed keys. It also fixes a musig() parser bug that silently accepted unexpected trailing characters, backed by a new unit test. One contributor (w0xlt) gave an ACK, but reviewer uqlidi raised an unanswered question about why the new overload hardcodes P2TR-only key rules rather than being generic. The PR is currently unreviewable as posted: it is labeled Needs rebase and its mergeable_state is dirty, and it conflicts with three other open descriptor PRs (#35742, #35445, #34697). Its value is mostly prospective, tied to GUI work that has not yet materialized.
